fields.description: Issue of Miami Life ("Florida's Most Influential Weekly") dated March 9, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 25). Includes editorials and commentary on Miami-area public issues such as telephone rate hearings and utility regulation, milk pricing, and proposed sterilization legislation in Florida, along with local political discussion. Also features extensive coverage and advertising related to horse racing (Hialeah/Tropical Park) and nightlife/entertainment listings and club promotions, plus columns and social notes.
